remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946... . No signature. On backing: In red ink by O'Keeffe, 'New Mexico Landscape/Mesa with Low Hills,' 1930 (oil) by Georgia O'Keeffe [probably by Stieglitz; not verified]. Also O'Keeffe Exhibition 1931. Note: This is probably one of the 'Landscapes near H & M Ranch' in 1931 exhibition. Owned Mrs. Arthur Schwab. Sent in to Amer. Place for refraining." Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Bought back by O'Keeffe from Schwabs." Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1935. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1930. Dated 1930 on basis of verso inscription, inclusion in 1931 New York (An American Place) exhibition, and Stieglitz—O'Keeffe correspondence. Pictured in 1931 New York (An American Place) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix LH, figure 44. Titled *NM Landscape/Mesa With Low Hills* by O'Keeffe on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph. See cat. nos. 1812, 1902. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Landscape Near H & M Ranch, Toward Abiquiú, N.M.

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: New Mexico Landscape, Mesa with Low Hills

description: The geometric forms of low gray and yellow hills run the width of the landscape. Standing above the hills is a tall, deep blue mesa. A thin band of bright blue sky with white clouds is visible overhead.
title: New Mexico Landscape, Mesa with Low Hills
